test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **them**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Them'** (pronoun) is used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

 
 
• ***For example -** I bathed the kids and read **them** stories.*
 
 
 
• Here, in the given paragraph the word **'them'** refers to **"the papers."**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'them'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ Salander sat for a while (1) __**holding**__ the telephone after Armansky hung up. She went to her work corner in the living room (2) __**and**__ looked at the notes she had pinned up on the wall and the papers she had (3) **__stacked__** on the desk. What she had managed to collect was mostly press cuttings and articles (4) __**downloaded**__ from the Internet. She took the papers and dropped** (5) __them__** in a desk drawer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'It'** is often used to refer to animals or non-living things. 
 
• **'They'** is used to refer to a person of unspecified gender.
 
• **'That'** is used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.
